snippet.title: Super FNaF 2 - Revival Trailer
snippet.description:
Super FNaF 2 Second Wind is a revived and improved version of the previously shelved Super FNaF 2 Wonderful Day.

Explore four worlds full of platforming, puzzles and boss fights as Circus Baby, and be a witness to a new unfamiliar scenario resulting from unusual deviations within the Freddy's timeline.

This second entry is an entirely stand-alone experience, and can be enjoyed by old fans and anyone entirely unfamiliar with the now unlisted original game alike.

The full game is officially slated to release at some point during quarter 4 of 2027. 
Please look forward to the wonderful day on which it is released.
